explanation: All 25 eta kinematic points passed EXCLURAD preflight. The phi scan uses 0, 15, ..., 345 degrees (25 values) and is chunked into 10, 10, and 5 points. Inputs use the validated eta campaign defaults: 6.53 GeV beam energy, vcut=0.166 GeV^2, and full O(alpha) radiative corrections. Radiative corrections depend on beam energy; use a different input set if another beam energy is intended.
